messages:
marta-partnerships: hi @evan-aurora quick data ask for the cost model: can you share a small CSV with region, sku, gpu_type, reserved_hourly_per_gpu, commit_months, spot_median_hourly, spot_p10, spot_p90, avg_eviction_pct_30d, cross_region_cov, listing_fee_pct, invoice_lag_days, billing_style, upfront_pct, prorate_policy, marketplace_credit_policy, notes? need it by EOD for the pricing run.
ev an-aurora: sure — uploaded a condensed sheet to the partner portal and pasted the head here. full sheet includes storage/egress rows and a column for preempt_recovery_min. link: https://partners.auroracloud.example/pricing/AU-pricing-2026

```csv
region,sku,gpu_type,reserved_hourly_per_gpu,commit_months,spot_median_hourly,spot_p10,spot_p90,avg_eviction_pct_30d,cross_region_cov,listing_fee_pct,invoice_lag_days,billing_style,upfront_pct,prorate_policy,marketplace_credit_policy,notes
us-central-1,AU-A100-40GB,A100-40GB,1.15,12,0.42,0.28,0.78,5,0.07,3.5,14,monthly_in_arrears,15,pro-rate-on-scale-down,accepts-platform-credits; fees-netted,reserved is per-GPU; storage separate
eu-north-1,AU-H100-80GB,H100-80GB,4.40,12,1.50,1.10,2.90,8,0.11,3.5,10,monthly_in_arrears,20,pro-rate+true-up,accepts-platform-credits; payout net fees,reserved per-instance (2 GPUs)
```

aurora-bot: File uploaded: AU-pricing-2026.csv (shared to #partnerships)

kai-finance: quick ask: can you include amortized_monthly_12mo_usd assuming 730h/month and whether upfront_pct is refundable on termination? this impacts accruals.
ev an-aurora: will add amortized_monthly_12mo_usd and refundable_upfront boolean. short note: upfront refundable only under negotiated ELA clauses; default = non-refundable.

tess-ops: ops question: cross_region_cov — is that pairwise correlation or a conservative multiplier? also what's median_preempt_recovery_min?
ev an-aurora: cross_region_cov is correlation in [0..1], intended to be used as an additive multiplier to simultaneous-eviction probability (modelers can map to 1+cov). median_preempt_recovery_min = 9 min typical, 25+ min during maintenance.

marta-partnerships: thanks — also can you confirm listing_fee handling: do you withhold the fee before vendor payout or invoice separately? we need to know for cashflow.
ev an-aurora: we withhold listing fee from vendor payouts; partners see net settlements. noted in the sheet as listing_fee_settlement = "withheld".

kai-finance: last ask: can you provide spot_slippage_pct (observed surge in spot price during high demand) and a p50->p90 uplift metric?
ev an-aurora: added spot_slippage_pct column; typical p50->p90 uplift = ~1.8x on H100 at peak. will paste numbers in the full CSV.

marta-partnerships: perfect — we'll ingest and run base-case 60/40 reserved/spot, sensitivity eviction +/-7pp and cross_region_cov +/-0.05. If any of the refund/prorate wording looks off we'll loop legal. thanks! :party-parrot:
